title: The first voice pre-laps under a full sting.
text: After a sting the body never starts flat: the sting plays its full length and the body's first voice starts under it (the user's fixes of 20261124: the host's question pre-lapped 2.16 s under a 4.04 s sting, in the YT and the 1-min).
